cssVars: Tree label, selected label and muted details
--accent; --primary on checked boxes; hover at 45% light / 40% dark

propDocs.Tree.mode: Single selection, multiple selection, or no selection.
propDocs.Tree.activation: Automatic selects focused items; manual waits for activation.
propDocs.Tree.expandOnPress: Lets a branch row toggle expansion.
propDocs.Tree.checkStrategy: Reports checked leaves, trunks, all branches, or independent items.
propDocs.Tree.keepMounted: Keeps collapsed groups mounted and hidden.
propDocs.Tree.hiddenUntilFound: Lets browser find in page expand a hidden branch.
propDocs.Tree.current: Marks the current page and expands its ancestors.
